key_insight: Lean can automatically construct a derivative, a correctness certificate, and a domain on which that derivative is guaranteed valid.
engineering_relevance: Certified differentiation offers a route to machine-checked derivative calculations for scientific computing and machine learning.
method: Reuse derivative theorems from Lean’s Mathlib library.
Use Lean metaprogramming to construct derivatives and certificates step by step.
Index derivative theorems by the functions they differentiate to accelerate search.
evidence_signal: With indexing, all 500 randomly generated test functions were differentiated at a median of 0.18 seconds per function, 8.6× faster than without indexing.
watch_item: Performance on randomly generated functions may not generalize to large real-world programs or functions lacking suitable Mathlib derivative theorems.
